import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD_CONST = 1000000007;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        int T = 1; // As per original code, T is fixed to 1
        for (int t = 0; t < T; t++) {
            run(scanner);
        }
        scanner.close();
    }

    static void run(Scanner scanner) {
        int total = scanner.nextInt();
        int factor = scanner.nextInt();

        int[] arr = new int[total];
        for (int i = 0; i < total; i++) {
            arr[i] = (int)((long)factor * i % total);
        }

        if (factor == 0) {
            System.out.println(powMod(total, total - 1, MOD_CONST));
            return;
        }

        boolean[] visitedList = new boolean[total];
        int[] cycleCount = new int[total + 1]; // size total+1 for safety
        long totalResult = 1;

        for (int startPoint = 0; startPoint < total; startPoint++) {
            if (visitedList[startPoint]) {
                continue;
            }
            int length = 0;
            int current = startPoint;
            while (!visitedList[current]) {
                visitedList[current] = true;
                current = arr[current];
                length++;
            }
            cycleCount[length]++;
        }

        for (int length = 1; length < total; length++) {
            int c = cycleCount[length];
            if (c != 0) {
                long totalVal = (long)length * c + (length > 1 ? 1 : 0);
                totalResult = (totalResult * powMod(totalVal, c, MOD_CONST)) % MOD_CONST;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(totalResult);
    }

    static long powMod(long base, long exp, long mod) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= mod;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
